request: Add a camel_to_snake helper to the code generator and use it wherever names are converted.

summary.result_text:
I added `camel_to_snake` to `lnbits/helpers.py`, but I haven't run any tests. The test commands needed approval and I didn't get it.

`lnbits/core/services/extensions_builder.py` (the code generator), `lnbits/core/models/extensions_builder.py` and `tests/unit/test_helpers.py` all already import `camel_to_snake` from `lnbits.helpers`. It was never defined there, so those imports would fail. The new function turns `CamelCaseName` into `camel_case_name`, which is what `test_helpers.py` expects. The existing call sites now resolve to it, so I didn't change any of them.

Two things I left alone:
- **TypeScript SDK generator:** `tools/codegen/extension_sdk_typescript.py` only converts snake_case to camelCase, so it has nothing for this helper to replace.
- **Other converters:** `_to_snake` in `lnbits/core/wasm_ext/api/runtime.py` also converts hyphens, so swapping it for the new helper would change its behavior. Say if you want it switched anyway.

To verify, run `make test-unit`, or just `tests/unit/test_helpers.py`.
